verdictRationale: Outcome 'automated_success' indicates compliance requirement is satisfied

registryEntry.label: Conditional Access Policy for Remote Access Sessions
registryEntry.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies').value | Where-Object { $_.state -eq 'enabled' -and ($_.displayName -like '*Remote*' -or $_.displayName -like '*VPN*' -or ((@($_.conditions.users.includeUsers) -contains 'All') -and (@($_.conditions.applications.includeApplications) -contains 'All') -and (@($_.grantControls.builtInControls | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0))) } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ displayName = $_.displayName; state = $_.state } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
evidence_commands: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies').value | Where-Object { $_.state -eq 'enabled' -and ($_.displayName -like '*Remote*' -or $_.displayName -like '*VPN*' -or ((@($_.conditions.users.includeUsers) -contains 'All') -and (@($_.conditions.applications.includeApplications) -contains 'All') -and (@($_.grantControls.builtInControls | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0))) } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ displayName = $_.displayName; state = $_.state; includeUsers = @($_.conditions.users.includeUsers); includeApplications = @($_.conditions.applications.includeApplications); builtInControls = @($_.grantControls.builtInControls) } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4

metadata.commandExecuted: [manual/evidence-only] Conditional Access Policy for Remote Access Sessions
